from solution import is_allowed_specific_char


def test_issue_example_mixed():
    """Example 'ABCDEFabcdef123450' contains only a-z, A-Z and 0-9 so is True."""
    # 6 upper + 6 lower + 6 digits = 18 allowed, 0 disallowed => True
    assert is_allowed_specific_char("ABCDEFabcdef123450") is True


def test_issue_lowercase_only():
    """String with only a-z contains only allowed characters so is True."""
    # 6 allowed + 0 disallowed = 6 total => True
    assert is_allowed_specific_char("abcdef") is True


def test_issue_uppercase_only():
    """String with only A-Z contains only allowed characters so is True."""
    # 6 allowed + 0 disallowed = 6 total => True
    assert is_allowed_specific_char("ABCDEF") is True


def test_issue_digits_only():
    """String with only 0-9 contains only allowed characters so is True."""
    # 6 allowed + 0 disallowed = 6 total => True
    assert is_allowed_specific_char("123450") is True


def test_issue_boundary_min_max():
    """Boundary chars 'azAZ09' are all in a-z, A-Z, 0-9 so is True."""
    # 2 lower bounds + 2 upper bounds + 2 digit bounds = 6 allowed, 0 disallowed => True
    assert is_allowed_specific_char("azAZ09") is True


def test_issue_rejects_space():
    """String with a space does not contain only a-z, A-Z and 0-9 so is False."""
    # 3 + 3 = 6 allowed, 1 disallowed, 6 + 1 = 7 total => False
    assert is_allowed_specific_char("ABC 123") is False


def test_issue_rejects_underscore():
    """Underscore is not in a-z, A-Z, 0-9 so '_' is False."""
    # 0 allowed + 1 disallowed = 1 total => False
    assert is_allowed_specific_char("_") is False


def test_issue_rejects_special_symbols():
    """String '*&%@#!}{' has no a-z, A-Z, 0-9 chars so is False."""
    # 0 allowed + 8 disallowed = 8 total => False
    assert is_allowed_specific_char("*&%@#!}{") is False


def test_issue_rejects_neighbors_outside_ranges():
    """Chars just outside a-z, A-Z, 0-9 are disallowed so is False."""
    # 0 allowed + 6 disallowed = 6 total => False
    assert is_allowed_specific_char("/:`@{[") is False


def test_issue_rejects_trailing_exclamation():
    """Mostly allowed 'abc123' with one '!' does not contain only allowed chars so is False."""
    # 6 allowed + 1 disallowed = 7 total => False
    assert is_allowed_specific_char("abc123!") is False


def test_contract_true_result_is_bool():
    """Allowed input must return boolean True per example '== True'."""
    # 3 allowed + 0 disallowed = 3 total => True
    result = is_allowed_specific_char("abc")
    assert result is True


def test_contract_false_result_is_bool():
    """Disallowed input must return boolean False to match 'only allowed' rule."""
    # 0 allowed + 1 disallowed = 1 total => False
    result = is_allowed_specific_char("!")
    assert result is False
